entries.why: All facts in IFC SII/ESRS 40616 (senior secured CNY loan; PS1-4,7; ESAP items). ESAP says "independent safety audit", not "third-party"; wording fixed.

ESRS 32522: PS list, ESAP items 1 (ESIA approval), 35-38 (land acquisition documentation under new procedure), 19 (third-party labour audit) and post-Board broad community support review all confirmed.
1994 PA Sch.2 paras 4, 9, 11 and 2002 PA RAP/TDP/IAG clauses confirmed. Agreement says "adjust", not "raise", seedling prices; fixed.
Loan 8145-LK Sch.2 Sec.D paras 1, 2, 5 confirmed (Bank approval, local disclosure before affected activities, contractor obligations).

P-2949-IND (onlending terms, FX risk on GOI, SLA effectiveness condition para 58/66, GOI bills by 15th per draft LA s.3.03) and PA 4.04/4.05 confirmed; no resettlement covenant in PA or special conditions. Terms are corporate-finance covenants that fit no tag, so ct stays empty (owner to decide).

Figures are in the SEC exhibit, but they are interest/schedule terms of unsecured owner loans drawn 1998-2001, not conditions IFC attached to money tied to the harm; "repay" (repayment security) does not fit subordinated unsecured debt.

Credit agreement ss.3.05(e), 3.07(b), 4.01(e), 5.01(b) and PA s.4.06(a) confirmed. "Regularly adjusted" came from the President's memo (negotiation assurances); replaced with binding PA s.4.06(c), which requires rate adjustments if the return test fails. Memo source dropped.

ICR 18091 para 7 lists the loan covenants by letter (Almatti three-year rule, full O&M recovery by fourth irrigation year, R&R plan, annual independent M&E); a completion report quoting the covenants for this loan is acceptable. OED 17542 para 2.10 benchmarks confirmed; added specifics.
LA 8066-IN Sch.2 I.B, I.F and PA paras 3, 6, 7, 8 confirmed.
FA 4751-ML Sch.1 Part 2(a) and Sch.2 safeguard paras 1-2 confirmed.
SAR 12527-CHA para 6.1(b),(c),(k),(l),(n) and 6.2 cross-effectiveness confirmed; SAR states these as agreements for this credit.
SAR 4289-IN (consultant report as effectiveness condition, 20% contribution, receivables, loss programme) and ICR 15676 para 27 resettlement assurance confirmed.
1969 appraisal report paras 1.15, 4.31, 9.04 and OED 3063 (special fund a condition of loan signature; loan agreement adopted "not less than 25 years") confirmed.
Credit 3690 PA Sch.1 para 2(a)-(c) confirmed.

Figures confirmed in Multinational Monitor (May 1981), but EXIM guarantees are support EXIM extended to lenders, not a condition the lenders imposed on the Philippines; "repay" does not fit without a source saying the money depended on a guarantee or collateral from the borrower.
PCM eligibility report (2011 sovereign-guaranteed EUR80m loan) and compliance review (2001 and 2003 loan agreements require independent environmental audit every three years) confirmed.

CRP paras 61, 77, 139, 170, 178 confirmed. JICA table says consultants "Bilateral tied", which is not the same as Japanese-only; now quoted as written. Attribution split between loan agreement and President's report as the CRP does.
Inspection Panel executive summary confirms the unenforced EIA covenant and no resettlement provisions in the 1999 supplementary loan; risk known from 1994.
CRP 2012 quotes the RRP and loan contract resettlement-plan clause and PAM suspension provision; confirmed.
LA 2990-NEP ss.3.01, 6.01(b) and Sch.4 paras 6-7 confirmed.
